title: Bitcoin: Mempool Size
note: Aggregate size in bytes of unconfirmed Bitcoin transactions waiting in the mempool, as observed across Blockchain.com's Bitcoin nodes. Unlike transaction count, byte size reflects how much block space the queue requires. The source is sampled intraday; this daily-close view keeps the last observation in each UTC day and omits the final observed day because it may be incomplete. It is not real-time.
